text:
ashwin: heads up — seeing intermittent validation failures for fncall responses only when using streaming. validator rejects entire tool response with `unexpected token` even though final assembled JSON is valid. likely due to partial chunks hitting strict schema check during assembly.

sarah: ouch. are these counted as rejects in the console?

ashwin: yeah, they show up as schema_rejects and increment the quota-meter. spikes in the last 6h correlate with a handful of high-concurrency clients.

jordan: I pulled the console timeline — we have a cluster of ~120 rejects between 10:12–10:20 UTC. routing shows these were to the canary variant. devops-bot reported the canary CPU bump at the same time.

devops-bot: canary-deploy-42: health ok, but 2xx->validation: 118 in 8m (sample id: c42-20260321).

elaine: product concern — if these count as hard rejects they can trigger auto-fallbacks and affect user visible outputs. we need to avoid false negatives.

kai: quick question: are these failures happening pre-assembly (per-chunk) or post-assembly? logs point to our streaming consumer throwing when it sees an incomplete JSON chunk.

ashwin: error originates in the schema validator invoked by the streaming adapter. code snippet: ```js
// simplified
stream.on('data', chunk => {
  try {
    validator.validate(JSON.parse(chunk)) // BAD: chunk may be partial
  } catch (e) {
    metrics.counter('fncall_stream_chunk_reject')
    throw e
  }
})
```

jordan: oh yeah that looks wrong — we should only validate after we assemble the full tool payload or use an incremental parser. current implementation treats each chunk as a standalone payload.

ashwin: proposed short-term fix: change validator call to only run on assembled payload. medium-term: add incremental JSON streaming validator that reports fragment-level warnings but not full rejects.

elaine: for the console/UX we should: 1) surface these as "stream-fragment warnings" not hard rejects in the main chart, 2) keep a separate metric for fragment-level noise so SRE/product can filter. we don't want customers seeing quota usage or fallbacks triggered by these.

sarah: agree. telemetry ask: add new metric fncall_stream_fragment_warning and keep existing fncall_schema_reject for final payload rejections. also tag metrics with sample_id, canary_id, route_id, and truncated_raw (redacted) so we can backfill.

kai: on sampling — we should capture raw assembly for 1% of failures with automatic PII redaction. query idea: `SELECT sample_id, route_id, error_type FROM fncall_errors WHERE kind='stream_fragment' AND rand() < 0.01`

jordan: console changes: add toggle in the validation panel "Show stream fragment activity" that expands inline traces. default off. owners can enable and see redacted raw chunks for sampled traces.

ashwin: rollout plan suggestion:
- hotfix: stop per-chunk validate (rollback in 1h)
- telemetry: emit fragment_warning metric + tags (2d)
- console: add toggle + sample viewer (2w)
- infra: investigate incremental parser (3w)

elaine: prioritize hotfix + telemetry today. if hotfix reduces noise, postpone incremental parser. product will update canary policy to ignore fragment_warnings for fallback triggers.

sarah: to be explicit about who does what: ashwin -> hotfix + metric emit; jordan -> console toggle mock + wireframe; kai -> sampling & redaction prototype; i'll update the canary rules to ignore fragment_* metrics. check-in EOD? :thumbsup:

ashwin: got it — will open PR for hotfix now and add tests reproducing chunked partials. PR will reference sample id c42-20260321.

jordan: I'll mock the UI and attach screenshots to the ticket.

kai: will sketch the redaction rules (remove 3 token windows around email/@ and credit-like patterns) and drop them into the sampling PR.

devops-bot: created incident-attach: INC-20260321-42 with labels [fncall, streaming, canary]. assigned to ashwin.

elaine: thanks team. appreciate quick triage. let's avoid alarm in the dashboard — we don't want CS pinging customers.

ashwin: updating the thread with the PR link when ready.

sarah: thanks — tagging this for the postmortem template too. we should have a short blameless writeup after the hotfix.

jordan: also a small UX note — show a time-limited banner when fragment sampling is enabled so users know raw traces are ephemeral and redacted.

ashwin: noted. all set for now.
